definitions.explanation: Doing or considering things separately, paying attention to each item rather than the whole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧。
examples.english: Solve the problems one by one.

examples.japanese: {一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ⟦{呼|よ}んで→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧いった。
examples.english: She called out each student's name one by one.

examples.japanese: {一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。

notes:
Emphasizes treating items individually rather than as a group. Conveys care, thoroughness, or deliberate attention to each element. Often used when someone wants to stress the importance of not rushing or skipping over details.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check each one
- {一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: carefully, one at a time
- {一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: each task
- {一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to deal with things one by one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧つ⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: one at a time — more neutral and less emphatic than {一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ
- ⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧: each; respectively — focuses on individual differences rather than sequential attention
- ⟦{個別|こべつ}→個別：11566_kobetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: individually — more formal and often used in business or official contexts

RELATED PATTERNS:
- The reduplication pattern extends to other counters: ⟦{一人一人|ひとりひとり}→一人一人：03711_hitorihitori⟧ (each person), ⟦{一歩一歩|いっぽいっぽ}→一歩一歩：09670_ippoippo⟧ (step by step), {一日一日|いちにちいちにち} (day by day)
